properties.description: Central nickel complex with four S ligands

nodes.name: Solvothermal Self-Assembly
nodes.procedure: Linker precursor HTHATN-R was synthesized according to our previous report[17] and characterized by ¹H and ¹³C NMR (Figure S1, Supporting Information). HTHATN-R and Ni(OAc)₂ were heated solvothermally in the mixture of N,N-dimethylacetamide, sodium tert-butoxide (tBuONa) and ethylenediamine (EDA) to afford black solid of HTHATN-Ni (Figure 1a,b). HTHATN-R was hydrolyzed in situ to yield HTHATN⁶⁻ species that subsequently coordinated to Ni²⁺ ions as supported by Fourier transform infrared (FT-IR) spectra (Figure S2, Supporting Information).
nodes.source_text: HTHATN-R and Ni(OAc)₂ were heated solvothermally in the mixture of N,N-dimethylacetamide... to afford black solid of HTHATN-Ni

nodes.name: Mechanical Exfoliation
nodes.procedure: HTHATN-Ni can be exfoliated into nanosheet, namely HTHATN-Ni-NS, by stirring in high-shear mixer.
nodes.source_text: HTHATN-Ni can be exfoliated into nanosheet... by stirring in high-shear mixer

nodes.name: Second Metal Installation
nodes.procedure: Pt-decorated HTHATN-Ni-NS, namely HTHATN-Ni-Pt-NS, were obtained by mixing H₂PtCl₆ aqueous solution and HTHATN-Ni-NS, followed by Xenon lamp irradiation for 4 h.
nodes.source_text: Pt-decorated HTHATN-Ni-NS... were obtained by mixing H₂PtCl₆ aqueous solution and HTHATN-Ni-NS, followed by Xenon lamp irradiation for 4 h

nodes.description: Photocatalytic hydrogen evolution under visible light (optimized conditions)
nodes.source_text: HTHATN-Ni-Pt-NS presented an average rate of 47.2 mmol g^{-1} h^{-1}, which is 13.5-fold higher than that of pristine HTHATN-Ni-NS... under visible light irradiation (λ >420 nm)

nodes.description: Photocatalytic hydrogen evolution under visible light (same conditions as test_1)
nodes.source_text: Under the same conditions, HTHATN-Ni-NS also exhibited efficient activity for hydrogen evolution yet at quite a low rate of 3.5 mmol g^{-1} h^{-1}

nodes.description: Control experiment - Pt0 nanoparticles physically mixed with HTHATN-Ni-NS
nodes.source_text: Pt@HTHATN-Ni-NS... the resultant activity was only 4.8 mmol g^{-1} h^{-1} that is far below that of HTHATN-Ni-Pt-NS

nodes.characterization_summary: PXRD patterns of HTHATN-Ni show AA' stacking with peaks at 3.34, 5.83, 6.68, 8.94, 11.67, and 26.23° attributed to (100), (110), (200), (120), (220), and (002) diffractions; parameters a = b = 30.63 Å, c = 6.64 Å.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The peaks at 3.34, 5.83, 6.68, 8.94, 11.67, and 26.23° are attributed to the (100), (110), (200), (120), (220), and (002) diffractions, respectively. The parameters of HTHATN-Ni are a = b = 30.63 Å, c = 6.64 Å

HER activity plot showing H₂ evolution (mmol/g) vs irradiation time (h)

nodes.characterization_summary: HTHATN-Ni is porous with hexagonal pore diameter of 2.50 nm, supported by pore size distribution centered at 2.45 nm calculated by NLDFT.
nodes.evidence_snippet: HTHATN-Ni is porous with a hexagonal pore diameter of 2.50 nm, which is supported by pore size distribution (centered at 2.45 nm) calculated from N2 adsorption isotherm by nonlocal density functional theory (NLDFT).

nodes.characterization_summary: HRTEM of HTHATN-Ni shows honeycomb pores and lattice fringes of 2.54 nm; interplanar spacing 0.33 nm for (002) π-π stacking; HTHATN-Ni-Pt-NS shows well-ordered lattice fringes and FTT patterns.
nodes.evidence_snippet: high-resolution transmission electron microscopy (HRTEM) image shows clearly the pores of honeycomb network and lattice fringes with a characteristic spacing distance of 2.54 nm (Figure 1f,g). The interplanar spacings of 0.33 nm found in HRTEM correspond to the π-π stacking distance of (002) facets

nodes.characterization_summary: EDS shows S, Ni, N, Na elements uniformly distributed on HTHATN-Ni; Pt and Cl well distributed on HTHATN-Ni-Pt-NS.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Energy dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDS) shows that S, Ni, N, Na elements were uniformly distributed on the HTHATN-Ni sample.

nodes.characterization_summary: XPS verifies Ni oxidation state and amounts in HTHATN-Ni; Pt 4f peaks at 76.1 and 72.6 eV confirm Pt²⁺ in HTHATN-Ni-Pt-NS; N 1s shows C=N decrease at 398.2 eV and C-N increase at 399.6 eV indicating Pt-phenanthroline coordination.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The oxidation states and amounts of Ni were also verified by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) ... Pt 4f spectrum of XPS exhibits two major peaks (4f5/2 and 4f7/2) at 76.1 and 72.6 eV, respectively, indicating Pt centers at oxidation state of +2

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni K-edge XANES confirms Ni²⁺ oxidation state in HTHATN-Ni; Pt L3-edge XANES of HTHATN-Ni-Pt-NS shows white-line intensity between Pt foil and PtO₂ confirming Pt²⁺.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Ni K-edge X-ray absorption near-edge structure (XANES) spectrum of HTHATN-Ni exhibits similar profile and a slightly lower edge energies to those of NiO and NiS, but quite different from Ni foil ... This suggests oxidation state of Ni to be +2

nodes.characterization_summary: EXAFS confirms Ni-S bonds in HTHATN-Ni and PtN₂Cl₂ unit in HTHATN-Ni-Pt-NS with R_Pt-N 2.03 Å and R_Pt-Cl 2.29 Å.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Least-squares fitting for EXAFS data show bond distances of 2.03 and 2.29 Å for both R_Pt-N and R_Pt-Cl with coordinated number of 2 revealing the PtN₂Cl₂ unit in HTHATN-Ni-Pt-NS.

nodes.characterization_summary: AFM analysis indicates HTHATN-Ni-Pt-NS thickness ≈5 nm corresponding to ≈15 coordination layers.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Atomic force microscopy (AFM) analysis indicates that the thicknesses of these nanosheets are ≈5 nm, corresponding to ≈15 coordination layers.

nodes.characterization_summary: UPS determines VB/CB of HTHATN-Ni as 0.55/-0.75 V vs SHE; HTHATN-Ni-Pt-NS as 0.25/-0.85 V vs SHE.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Ultraviolet photoelectron spectroscopy (UPS) was used to determine the valance band (VB) and the conduction band (CB).

nodes.characterization_summary: EIS shows HTHATN-Ni-Pt-NS has smaller radius than HTHATN-Ni-NS, indicating lower charge-transfer resistance.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Meanwhile, electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) shows that HTHATN-Ni-Pt-NS is more electron-conductive with a smaller radius, indicative of a lower charge-transfer resistance.

nodes.characterization_summary: ICP-AES verifies Ni amounts in HTHATN-Ni and Pt content of 0.46 wt% in HTHATN-Ni-Pt-NS.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The oxidation states and amounts of Ni were also verified by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) and inductively coupled plasma atomic emission spectrometry (ICP-AES) measurement respectively ... ICP-AES results show that the Pt content in the above HTHATN-NiPt-NS is 0.46 wt%.

nodes.characterization_summary: HAADF-STEM confirms Pt and Cl distribution on HTHATN-Ni-Pt-NS and shows individual Pt single atoms; no Pt⁰ particles observed.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Elemental mapping image indicates that Pt and Cl elements are well distributed on the sample ... aberration corrected HAADF-STEM image shows obvious individual Pt atoms in HTHATN-Ni-Pt-NS
